candidates.title: The Seeds That Sprouted Out of Order
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the school garden's dated seed trays germinated in the reverse of their planting schedule before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they replanted the oldest trays but the sequence remained wrong; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized warmth from a buried heating pipe reached the newest trays first; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they moved the trays to equal temperatures and updated the planting schedule, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Window That Sang at Noon
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the clinic's glass window made a piercing tone each midday before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they padded the window frame but the sound continued; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized sunlight heated an exposed metal vent that vibrated against the glass; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they installed a flexible spacer and checked the ventilation airflow, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Message With a Missing Flash
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the harbor's rescue signal always lost its third flash before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced the lamp bulb but the pattern stayed incomplete; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a turning weather vane briefly blocked the beam on each rotation; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they raised the signal above the vane and verified the full code offshore, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
